name: Iron Depths
description: The mighty dwarven underground kingdoms, featuring vast forge halls, deep mines, and mountain strongholds

musicalTheme.instruments: Deep brass, timpani, anvil percussion, pipe organ undertones

tracks.name: Halls of the Mountain King
tracks.sunoPrompt: Deep dwarven forge theme in E minor with resonant brass fanfares and thunderous anvil percussion strikes and powerful pipe organ undertones with vast echoing cavern hall atmosphere and proud industrial rhythm at steady marching pulse with mountain kingdom majesty and masterful craftsmanship

tracks.name: The Anvil and Ale
tracks.sunoPrompt: Hearty dwarven tavern music in E minor with boisterous accordion melody and stomping boot rhythms and deep bass drone with warm underground pub atmosphere and merry drinking song energy at robust tempo with tankard-slamming camaraderie and forge-worker celebration

tracks.name: The Master Craftsman's Hall
tracks.sunoPrompt: Industrious dwarven shop music in E minor with rhythmic hammer-on-anvil accents and steady deep brass undertones and mechanical gear sounds with busy forge marketplace atmosphere and proud craftsman rhythm at working tempo with quality metalwork and gemstone trading

tracks.name: The Deep Pools
tracks.sunoPrompt: Peaceful underground fishing music in E minor with echoing cavern water drips and deep resonant drone tones and distant pipe organ hum with subterranean lake atmosphere and patient contemplative rhythm at slow tempo with cavernous stillness and dwarven patience

tracks.name: The Lost Forgehalls
tracks.sunoPrompt: Ancient dwarven ruins music in E minor with mournful deep brass lament and scattered distant anvil echoes and haunting pipe organ chords with abandoned mine atmosphere and mysterious puzzle-solving tension at slow tempo with cold forge silence and faded glory of master craftsmen
